# Research rederive

Load `.agents/skills/research-rederive/SKILL.md` first.

Identify the exact claim and source. Re-derive independently. Check dimensions, signs, limits, and one adversarial case. Mark each result with the epistemic legend. Do not label generated reasoning as executed unless a tool result in this turn shows the check.

Finish with the claim ledger and the single most decisive unresolved check. If the user asks for a brief or HTML, stop and name `research-publisher`.
